content.text:
Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/final/case-30008.json runs/final-case-30008-r1

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30008-r1 --slot 0 --why "Earliest reachable slot, separates the 0-2 and 1-2 pairs at the capped maximum separation, good first discriminator"

python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30008-r1 --slot 3 --why "Candidate 1 has collapsed, remaining live pair is 0 versus 2, this is the earliest slot offering maximal separation for that pair"

python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30008-r1 --slot 4 --why "Support has already crossed the resolution threshold for candidate 0 after only two observations, taking one confirmation point at the earliest remaining slot to guard against a single noisy measurement"

content.text: Confirmed — support remains 1.0 for candidate 0 (period 9.278 d), well above theta=0.997, with 3 observations left unused. Finalizing.

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli finalize --run runs/final-case-30008-r1 --why "Candidate 0 at period near 9.28 days reached support 1.0 after slot 0 and slot 3, confirmed with an additional point at slot 4, the other two candidates collapsed to zero support and no live pair remains to test"

content.text: Campaign resolved: candidate 0 (period ≈ 9.278 d) selected with support 1.0 (theta = 0.997), using 3 of 6 observations (slots 0, 3, confirmation at 4).

result: Campaign resolved: candidate 0 (period ≈ 9.278 d) selected with support 1.0 (theta = 0.997), using 3 of 6 observations (slots 0, 3, confirmation at 4).
